name: withsmall
description: WithSmall (위드스몰) — 소동물·앵무새 사육 준비·구매·관리 오케스트레이션. 모노레포(client + server).

scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && npm run prerender && node scripts/precompress.mjs
scripts.dev:check-search: npm run build -w server && node --env-file-if-exists=server/.env scripts/dev/check-search-keywords.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace client && npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint:e2e
